interpretation_rule: Descriptive diagnostic. Retaining 85-91% of a raw RankIC after residualization means most of the ranking edge is not style exposure; a lower retained share would mean part of the edge is. No scheme is promoted, no threshold is applied, and research_a/research_b are already-used selection data.
limitations: The official M.jyc_eval preprocessing is unavailable, so winsorization strength, standardization, exposure timing, regression weights and missing-value handling are frozen local choices, not official parameters.
Exposure snapshots lag the signal by one trading day; a same-day snapshot cannot be shown to be published before the intraday timestamp.
research_a and research_b were already used for scheme selection, so cross-scheme contrasts are descriptive and not independent confirmation.
Long-short returns are gross forward-label returns with no fees, execution, overlap or compounding adjustment.
Two ten-day windows and three seeds bound the statistical evidence; block-bootstrap intervals describe day-level sampling noise only.
No model was trained and no scheme is promoted; the retained reference remains the raw-label 10-day seed-11 run.

official_reference.consequence: The pipeline below is a local approximation frozen before any result of this round was computed. It is not the official preprocessing and no official score is produced.
evidence: 比赛说明.txt states only: 校验通过后，平台对原始因子统一处理：去极值 与 标准化。风格剔除：将因子对 BARRA 风险因子回归，取残差作为新因子，以评估其增量贡献。
No jyc_eval module, wheel or notebook exists in the workspace, the data-platform JSON or the official demo scripts.

The online notebook environment is not reachable from this offline checkout, and the configured web-search provider is unavailable, so the official winsorization parameters, standardization, exposure snapshot date, regression weighting and missing-value handling cannot be inspected.

risk_model.exposure_date_evidence: the exposure table is daily at midnight and its ret column is the same day's return: ret(date t) equals the t-1 -> t float_market_cap ratio for 98.95% of 2023 observations with median absolute difference 0. A row is therefore an end-of-day snapshot whose intraday publication time is unverified, so the previous trading day is the conservative choice.
risk_model.exposure_date_rule: use the most recent exposure date strictly before the signal date (previous trading day); every one of the eight timestamps of a day uses that same snapshot; same-day rows are never used and there is no forward fill

regression.industry_encoding: all 32 industry dummies (they span the intercept)
regression.label_use: the training/evaluation label never enters the residualization; only the post-residual ranking metrics read target returns
regression.weighting: equal (ordinary least squares); the official weights column is not used

score_preprocess.invariance_note: ranking metrics are invariant to monotone transforms, so winsorization and standardization affect only the regression fit
score_preprocess.winsorize: per timestamp, clip at median +/- 3 * 1.4826 * MAD; if MAD is zero fall back to the population standard deviation; a constant section becomes zeros

risk_model.uncovered_stock: a stock without a previous-day exposure row is dropped from that timestamp for every scheme, seed and variant; the same exclusion applies to the raw comparison variant
risk_model.weights_note: the official weights column sums to about 0.209 per day over the 999 evaluation names, i.e. it is normalized over a broader universe than the evaluation pool; that is one more reason not to use it as a regression weight

schemes.cand_centered: label centered by the full-timestamp training mean (control)

scope: local approximation of the official preprocessing; no official score
